name: Calle Larios Street Parking
description: Free street parking near the iconic Calle Larios pedestrian zone. Disk required on weekdays.
notes: Free on weekends and public holidays

name: Parking Alcazaba
description: Underground paid parking directly beneath the Alcazaba fortress. Open 24/7.

name: Paseo del Parque
description: Open street parking along the famous Paseo del Parque boulevard.
notes: Free but limited availability near the Cathedral

name: Playa La Malagueta
description: Large free parking area near La Malagueta beach. Very popular on summer weekends.

name: Parking El Corte Inglés
description: Paid underground parking at El Corte Inglés. Free first hour with any purchase.

name: Soho Arts District
description: Street parking in Málaga's Soho arts district. Blue zone, parking disk required.
address: Calle Casas de Campos, Soho, Málaga
notes: Blue zone disk available at tourist offices

name: Puerto de Málaga – Muelle Uno
description: Port area paid parking, convenient for cruise passengers and Muelle Uno restaurants.

name: Pedregalejo Residential
description: Residential street parking in the charming Pedregalejo fishing neighborhood.
notes: Residents priority, usually available from 9 pm

name: El Palo Beach Parking
description: Free open parking near El Palo beach. Popular with local families.
address: Avenida Salvador Allende, El Palo, Málaga
notes: Popular on weekends, arrive early in summer

name: Campus Universitario Teatinos
description: Large free parking area near the University of Málaga campus.

name: Carrefour Málaga
description: Free customer parking at Carrefour hypermarket. Requires in-store ticket validation.

name: Parking Plaza Mayor
description: Large paid parking at Plaza Mayor shopping and leisure centre.
notes: First 2 hours free with purchase, €1.50/h after

name: Estación de Autobuses
description: Paid parking adjacent to the main Málaga bus station.

name: Avenida Andalucía – Variable Zone
description: Parking rules vary by block along this avenue. Always check local signage before parking.
notes: Some blocks free, some ORA zone — verify on-site

name: Barrio Lagunillas
description: This residential zone is being redeveloped. Parking status unclear — verify on-site.
notes: Check local signage — regulations may have changed
